newsitem.title: POLAND: BOS seen flat or falling after debut.
newsitem.headline: BOS seen flat or falling after debut.

text.p: Polish Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA (BOS) soared 65.5 percent to 48 zlotys in heavy trade on its bourse debut but analysts saw it flat or falling in profit-taking in the next few sessions.
Analysts said many investors might want to sell the stock, which started trade higher than some expectations of a price of about 40 zlotys.

"I think the scenario might be similar to other bourse debuts when a surge at first listing is followed by profit-taking or at least stabilisation, especially given the high debut price," one trader said.
Some analysts said the bank looked attractive with a 4.6 price-earnings ratio seen for 1997, lower than the overall banking sector's current P/E of 9.9.
BOS, whose turonver on Monday was the session's highest at 11.3 million zlotys, is listed on the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
